sources.supportingExcerpt: People from the following categories in European countries may obtain a Visa on Arrival ... Tourists

policies.title: Swiss ordinary passports: Bangladesh visa on arrival
policies.summary: Bangladesh Police Special Branch states that tourists from European countries may obtain a visa on arrival at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka.
conditions: Applies to Swiss ordinary-passport tourists as members of the page's European-country category, for arrival at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka.
The visa is a single-entry visa for no more than 30 days and is issued only after the immigration officer reviews the required documents and compliance.
Applicants must meet the stated passport, return-ticket, funds and fee requirements and should use the same port for entry and departure.
This policy does not cover prohibited-country cases, work, residence, study, transit, diplomatic or official passports, special travel documents, or final admission.
